items.t: Rear brakes grinding from stuck outer pads
items.job: Replace rear pads and rotors and service caliper slides
items.note: A seized caliper adds cost. Price is for both rear wheels.

items.t: Driver mirror glass shakes at highway speed
items.job: Replace driver mirror glass or mirror assembly

items.note: Check your insurance glass coverage. Camera recalibration adds cost on equipped models.

items.t: Rust and paint blisters on the liftgate
items.job: Treat rust and repaint lower liftgate
items.note: Body shop rates vary. Ask a Mazda dealer whether the corrosion warranty helps.
Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Overheating or no heat with code P011A
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated badly.

items.job: Retighten or replace front strut mounting bolts
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Fuel filler pipe can rupture in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace or add protector to fuel filler pipe
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.job: Replace headlamp assembly with LED running light
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer. Price is per side.

items.t: Mazda Connect screen ghost touches, freezing and reboots
items.note: Mazda extended screen coverage and settled a class action. Check your VIN with a dealer first.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not deploy properly (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer. Price is per side.

items.t: Misfire or stalling from cylinder deactivation fault (recall)
items.job: Update engine software and inspect valve train
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN. If valve train parts are damaged, the repair costs more.
Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.
